name: Mia Sorrento
source:
Mia is [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Torque]Torque[/url]'s right hand. Another member of the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Anarch]Anarchs[/url] who previously led her unlife in the shadow of Boss [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Douglas_Callihan]Callihan[/url], and was trying to maintain a level of independence from the old [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Baron_(VTM)]Baron[/url]. Naturally, this made her gravitate more and more toward Torque, thus beginning their long-term cooperation. 

Mia sees in Torque everything an Anarch Baron should be, and she's eager to recruit new [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Kindred_(VTM)]Kindred[/url] to their cause. However, she's painfully aware that spies - both Callihan's and the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Camarilla_(VTM)]Camarilla[/url]'s - may be waiting for an opportune moment to uproot all of what the two Anarchs have spent so many years building.

[From the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266750/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Coteries_of_New_York_Artbook/]Artbook[/url]]
